```yaml
name: Portability Validation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Daily at 2:00 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'qumun/**'
      - 'main.go'
      - 'Makefile'

jobs:
  portability-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        kernel-version: ['6.12.2', '6.13', '6.14', '6.15', '6.16', '6.17']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Cache Docker layers
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: /tmp/.buildx-cache
          key: buildx-${{ github.sha }}-${{ matrix.kernel-version }}
          restore-keys: |
            buildx-${{ github.sha }}-
            buildx-

      - name: Build with specific kernel version
        run: |
          make KERNEL_VERSION=${{ matrix.kernel-version }} clean build

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          make KERNEL_VERSION=${{ matrix.kernel-version }} test
```
